structure.unit: Assistant to the Governor for Intergovernmental Affairs

law.catch_line: Cooperation with Department of Planning and Budget; supplemental assistance
law.text: The Assistant to the Governor shall be charged with the coordination of his work with that of the Virginia Department of Planning and Budget. The Department of Planning and Budget shall provide the Assistant to the Governor with such support, beyond that provided for in §§ 2.2-301 and 2.2-302, as may prove necessary.
